plain_text:
UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT 
SOUTHERN DISTRICT OF NEW YORK 
KATESPADELLC tal. StS 

                        Plaintiffs,                 23-CV-05409 (LGS) (VF) 
            -against-                                     ORDER 
VINCI BRANDS LLC, et al., 
                        Defendants. 
VALERIE FIGUEREDO, United States Magistrate  Judge 
Kate Spade LLC, Coach Services, Inc., and Tapestry, Inc. filed a motion to seal Exhibits 
B, D, and F  to the Letter Motion Requesting Permission to Reopen Depositions at ECF No. 381 
but did not put forth a basis for sealing other than relying on the stipulation and confidentiality 
order at ECF No. 193. Similarly, Kate Spade LLC filed a motion to provisionally seal Exhibits F 
and G to its Motion for Leave to File a Third Amended Complaint at ECF No. 303 but did not 
put forth a basis for permanently sealing the documents. 
The provisional seals on ECF No. 304, ECF No. 305, and ECF No. 382 will be lifted if a 
showing is not made under Lugosch v. Pyramid Co. of Onondaga, 435 F.3d 110 (2d Cir. 2006). 
Interested parties are directed to file their submission in support of permanently sealing the 
documents by November 1, 2024. 
SO ORDERED. 
DATED:     New York, New York                         
      October 23, 2024                  \ \ 4  iM   \ 
                                     UW  UA 
                                   VALERIE FIGUEREDO 
                                    United States Magistrate Judge
